title: Down the Long Diagonal
setup: Black's king is boxed into h8, and one of its rooks has parked on the long dark diagonal.
hint: The black king on h8 sits at the end of one famous diagonal. Which of your pieces can claim the other end?
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Bb2}} takes the a1–h8 diagonal, where the rook on **e5** is now stuck in front of its own king. The rook is attacked, undefended, and may not step aside. Unpinning with a king move arrives one move too late.
